description: FRIC-1781460000 (ADR-0551 hardening) — THE PR/PUSH SYMMETRY FOIL, binding evidence the orphaned-entry bug class is now caught at PR time. The candidate ADDS an OWNERS file that renders presubmit.yml owned, so the key drops out of the candidate's cloud-ci-total-accounting/unowned set (current AND proposed). The FROZEN merge-base reference still carries it under unowned — it predates the PR's OWNERS addition (frozen-policy-wins / merge-base-frozen reference). The live sign-off door still admits that now-orphaned key. The PREVIOUS detector required absence from the frozen face too, so frozen-presence VETOED the inert verdict → the PR passed GREEN, then dev went RED post-merge once the merge-base advanced past the OWNERS file (the false-green #718 hit). With inert-ness read against the CANDIDATE tree alone, the orphaned entry is INERT and the firewall FAILS CLOSED at PR time — symmetric with the push tier. No compare-mode code fails and there is no ratchet growth; the inert entry ALONE flips the verdict. Remediation: retire the entry (cloud-ci-firewall-signoff-fixer --fix). The GREEN twin tc-FW-good-owners-addition-with-entry-retired proves retiring the entry restores GREEN.
